_purpose: Drives scripts/verify-doc-coverage.py, the source-to-docs half of the documentation gates. verify-doc-citations.py runs docs-to-source and finds STALE references; this finds MISSING ones. A validity gate cannot see the entry that was never made, so both directions are needed.

surfaces.why: The module authoring contract. Five additions to it shipped undocumented on 2026-08-16/17 while every gate stayed green; this surface exists so that cannot recur.
The bot surface modules call, plus lifecycle. The task registry and hook fanout shipped undocumented.
Outbound pipeline; redact_secrets is security-relevant and its scope is easy to misstate.
Credential resolution. A new secret tier or accessor must not appear silently.
Persistence and rate limiting; both are cited across the operational docs.
Tamper-evidence surface; its guarantees are stated in several documents.
Password hashing. A new algorithm must reach the security model.

trees.why: Every command module needs a page; a new module must not land undocumented.
Every provider sub-package needs a page.

counts.why: Hard-coded in prose and went stale at 40 against 43. Either generated or checked; never hand-maintained.
